claims: The SpaceX Falcon 9 is a two-stage rocket.
The SpaceX Falcon 9 is designed for transport of satellites and the Dragon spacecraft to orbit.
The SpaceX Falcon 9 features a reusable first stage with nine Merlin engines.
The first stage of the SpaceX Falcon 9 has achieved over 578 successful landings as of April 2026.
Individual boosters of the SpaceX Falcon 9 have been reused up to 34 times as of April 2026.
The SpaceX Falcon 9 is designed for transport of payloads to Low-Earth Orbit (LEO).
The SpaceX Falcon 9 is designed for transport of payloads to Geostationary Transfer Orbit (GTO).
The SpaceX Falcon 9 is designed for crew/cargo missions to the International Space Station (ISS).
The SpaceX Falcon 9 is powered by liquid oxygen and rocket-grade kerosene (RP-1).
The SpaceX Falcon 9 is capable of lifting over 17,500 kg (38,600 lbs) of Starlink satellites.
The SpaceX Falcon 9 reuses its first-stage booster and fairing halves.
